title: Blind weight edits for language confusion in Qwen3.5-0.8B and Qwen3.5-2B
description: Code for a study that asks whether Claude Opus 5.5, acting as a blind editor, can cut cross-lingual language confusion in Qwen3.5-0.8B and Qwen3.5-2B by editing their weights directly, with no training. Five editor runs (four on the 0.8B model, one on the 2B model) are compared with published training-free fixes on the Language Confusion Benchmark (Marchisio et al., arXiv:2406.20052). The frozen edits are also checked on two other cross-lingual prompt sets, on Global-MMLU, MGSM and IFEval, under greedy decoding and longer answers, and with a blind LLM judge.
